bio: A tip to start with: reserve well in advance! Given the great value for money and the relaxed atmosphere, it's no surprise that they tend to get booked up. They call themselves the Bavarian Deli. In the interior done out in a slick Alpine/country-style style, the service is personable and relaxed. At lunchtime you can order pasta, a pastrami sandwich, ramen or the fish dish of the day à la carte, or the three-course business lunch. In the evening, creative modern cuisine is served in the form of a set menu – a vegetarian or pescetarian version is also available (request this when you book). There is also a wine bar next door....
